risk.rationale: Confirmed impossible travel (F1): Bucharest → İzmir in 12 minutes for t.bulut@aegean.edu, mapped to T1078.004 (Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts). A single confirmed session cannot physically traverse that distance in that time, indicating the account credentials are being used from geographically impossible locations — consistent with account takeover. No rejected claims or data-quality conflicts exist to explain the signal away. This is a confirmed, not weak, indicator, so contain is appropriate rather than monitor/benign; no conflicting evidence requires escalation.
